description: Add a repository that ships a marketplace.json catalog. Its plugins appear in the browse grid, just like Claude Code's plugin marketplaces.
emptyCatalog: This marketplace lists no plugins yet. You can still add it — anything published later shows up on the next refresh.
label: Marketplace repository
recommendedHint: Or paste any GitHub repository above.
removeDescription: Its plugins leave the browse grid. Plugins you already installed from it stay installed and keep working.
title: GitHub marketplace sources
unreviewed: cognia doesn't review these plugins. They run with the permissions they request — check the repository before you install anything from it.
